description: Use when enabling shadows in a Three.js scene or debugging shadow artifacts like acne, peter panning, or low resolution. Prevents the common mistake of wrong shadow camera frustum, too many PointLight shadows, or missing castShadow/receiveShadow flags. Covers shadow map types, per-light config, bias tuning, CameraHelper debugging. Keywords: shadows, shadowMap, shadow acne, peter panning, bias, normalBias, castShadow, receiveShadow, PCFSoftShadowMap, shadow camera, shadows not showing, shadow artifacts, enable shadows.
